klipler.istem: The glowing figure-eight line pulses softly with light while the dancing bee wags and the ring of bees stays still, slow camera push-in, golden dust motes drift. 3D animation style preserved.
Soft sun rays slowly sweep across the meadow, the grass and flowers sway gently in the breeze, light flares softly. Slow camera glide forward. 3D animation style preserved.
